## Analysis

The new 1.083299 record came from the tensor lineage, but its winning map has `c=0`; thus the gain came from changing the projection to `q=56` and optimizing occupied cells, not from bilinear distortion. This reverses the earlier conclusion that linear re-embedding was exhausted: projection-only sweeps failed because the mask and projection must be co-optimized. The unchanged cardinality `n=277` suggests additions/deletions balanced rather than sparsification. Broad structural families and small-set searches remain decisively inferior, so effort should concentrate on deeper mask optimization around this newly discovered linear projection.
